<p style="font-size:1.25em;">
For most of human history, living standards barely changed. Then, beginning around 1700, they took off. Behind that takeoff was a new way of organizing economic life: capitalism, built on private property, markets, and firms. This course is about the nuts and bolts of how that system works.
</p>

ECON 201 | Fall 2026 | College of Business and Economics | California State University
